logfile_text: Path to an Apex Debug Log file (*.log) in the workspace folder.
stop_on_entry_text: Stop the debugger after launching. If false, the debugger will run until it hits a breakpoint.
trace_text: Produce diagnostic output. You can set this to true, false, or one or more selectors separated with commas. Selectors include 'all' (very detailed output; the equivalent of true), 'protocol', 'logfile', 'launch', 'breakpoints'.
apexReplayDebugger.configuration.title: Salesforce Apex Replay Debugger
extension_level_notifications_descriptio: Notification style for all Apex Replay Debugger commands. Overrides the global salesforcedx-vscode-services.notifications setting. Individual commands can be further overridden in salesforcedx-vscode-apex-replay-debugger.commandLevelNotifications.
command_level_notifications_description: Notification style for each Apex Replay Debugger command. Overrides the global salesforcedx-vscode-services.notifications and extension-level salesforcedx-vscode-apex-replay-debugger.extensionLevelNotifications settings.
Show progress and success as toast notifications.
notifications.progressToastSuccessOff.de: Show progress as a cancellable toast, but suppress the success notification.
notifications.progressStatusBarSuccessSt: Show progress spinner and success message in the status bar.
notifications.progressStatusBarSuccessOf: Show progress spinner in the status bar, but suppress the success notification.
notifications_apex_test_class_descriptio: Notification style when debugging an Apex test class (applies to both 'SFDX: Launch Apex Replay Debugger with Selected File' on a .cls file and the 'Debug Tests' codelens).
notifications_anonymous_apex_description: Notification style when debugging Anonymous Apex (applies to 'SFDX: Launch Apex Replay Debugger with Selected File' on a .apex file, the 'Debug' codelens, and 'SFDX: Debug Anonymous Apex with Editor's Selected Text').
notifications_update_checkpoints_descrip: Notification style for checkpoint upload operations (progress only; no success notification). Applies to both the 'SFDX: Update Checkpoints in Org' command and the checkpoint upload step when debugging Apex tests.
